newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian Orthodox leader taken to hospital.
newsitem.headline: Russian Orthodox leader taken to hospital.

text.p: Alexiy II, the patriarch of the Russian Orthodox church, has been taken to hospital with pneumonia, a church official said on Wednesday.

The official did not say how long the 67-year-old patriarch was likely to stay in Moscow's Central Clinical Hospital or if he would be back in time to celebrate Christmas, which falls on January 7 under the Orthodox calendar.
Alexiy, born in the Estonian city of Tallinn, has headed the Russian church since 1990.
